discription: Pulse wave synthesizer with pulse width modulation and a resonant low-pass filter, offering a dynamic and rich timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, pwmRate=2, pwmDepth=0.4, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5; var sig, env, pwMod; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); pwMod = (SinOsc.kr(pwmRate) * pwmDepth) + pulseWidth; sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pwMod.clip(0.01, 0.99)); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
